cases.name: baseline
cases.reason: The unmodified frozen xadb-engine library must compile before ownership rejection is accepted.

cases.name: installed
cases.reason: AllocationSession consumes the installed DoublewriteStorageSession; using the moved installed owner must fail.

cases.name: frame
cases.reason: AllocationSession retains the exclusive metadata frame borrow until its last use.

cases.name: operation
cases.reason: AllocationSession retains the exclusive operation workspace borrow until its last use.

cases.name: flush
cases.reason: AllocationSession transitively retains the exclusive doublewrite flush workspace borrow until its last use.

cases.name: slot
cases.reason: AllocationSession transitively retains the exclusive WAL slot borrow until its last use.

cases.name: release
cases.reason: Dropping AllocationSession returns all four caller borrows: metadata frame, operation workspace, flush workspace and WAL slot.
